negara_sejahtera.title: 번영하는 국가
negara_sejahtera.description: 국가 복지 지수를 이전 목표치보다 +10씩 올려 최고 목표치 100/100을 달성하세요.

kebahagiaan_merata.title: 골고루 누리는 행복
kebahagiaan_merata.description: 시민 만족도를 단계별로 +10씩 높여 최대 100%에 도달하세요.

rumah_untuk_semua.title: Homes for All
rumah_untuk_semua.description: Eliminate housing deficits or reduce homelessness to minimum levels.

layanan_untuk_semua.title: Services for All
layanan_untuk_semua.description: Fulfill fundamental population needs such as food, electricity, housing, and public spaces.

penduduk_sehat.title: 건강한 국민
penduduk_sehat.description: 공중 보건을 관리하여 질병 및 전염병 사망률을 20% 미만으로 억제하세요.

pertumbuhan_terjaga.title: 안정적인 성장
pertumbuhan_terjaga.description: 인구 증가율을 6개월 연속 흑자(+)로 유지하세요 (적자 금지). 힌트: 식량, 주거, 치안을 유지하여 인구 감소를 예방하세요.

mandiri_energi.title: Energy Independence
mandiri_energi.description: Cover national electricity needs without deficit for multiple in-game months.

lumbung_pangan.title: National Granary
lumbung_pangan.description: Fulfill national food requirements and maintain a production surplus.

anggaran_sehat.title: 건전한 재정
anggaran_sehat.description: {periodText} 동안 국가 재정 흑자와 국고 안정을 유지하세요 (목표 평가일: {targetDate}).

bebas_utang.title: Debt Free
bebas_utang.description: Repay all active sovereign loans and debts in full.

mitra_dagang_dunia.title: 세계 무역 파트너
mitra_dagang_dunia.description: 글로벌 무역 시장에서 판매, 구매, 전량 판매를 진행하여 국고를 늘리세요.

daya_beli_terjaga.title: 안정된 구매력
daya_beli_terjaga.description: 필수 생필품 가격에 대한 국민 만족도를 단계별 목표(65, 75, 80) 이상으로 유지하세요. 수령 시 다음 단계 활성화!

pembangun_bangsa.title: Nation Builder
pembangun_bangsa.description: Construct production, public service, and residential complexes.

pelayanan_publik_lengkap.title: Comprehensive Public Care
pelayanan_publik_lengkap.description: Establish education, health, and diverse public service facilities.

negeri_inovatif.title: Innovative Realm

lompatan_teknologi.title: Technological Leap
lompatan_teknologi.description: Upgrade multiple research development cards to advanced tiers.

riset_untuk_rakyat.title: Research for the People
riset_untuk_rakyat.description: Complete research directly bolstering economy, welfare, or crisis mitigation.

kabinet_andal.title: Reliable Cabinet
kabinet_andal.description: Appoint qualified ministers across all key ministerial portfolios.

pemerintahan_profesional.title: Professional Governance
pemerintahan_profesional.description: Upgrade administrative ministries to target capability levels.

layanan_siaga.title: Alert Emergency Services
layanan_siaga.description: Enhance emergency response and public healthcare readiness.

diplomat_ulung.title: Master Diplomat
diplomat_ulung.description: Establish embassies and cultivate strong ties with multiple nations.

tetangga_bersahabat.title: Friendly Neighbors
tetangga_bersahabat.description: Enact non-aggression pacts or mutual cooperation accords with neighbors.

jaringan_global.title: Global Network
jaringan_global.description: Join several international or regional multilateral organizations.

suara_dunia.title: World Voice
suara_dunia.description: Participate in UN sessions and achieve decisive diplomatic outcomes.

masyarakat_harmonis.title: Harmonious Society
masyarakat_harmonis.description: Attain targeted societal tolerance and civil satisfaction metrics.

identitas_nasional.title: National Identity
identitas_nasional.description: Establish national ideology, state faith, or doctrine while securing social order.

kebijakan_inklusif.title: Inclusive Policies
kebijakan_inklusif.description: Reach target milestones in civic freedom and open governance.

penjaga_negeri.title: Guardian of the Realm
penjaga_negeri.description: Construct defense installations and maximize naval/armed forces readiness.

mata_telinga_negara.title: Eyes and Ears of the State

wilayah_terkelola.title: Integrated Territory
wilayah_terkelola.description: Stabilize and develop captured or annexed territorial provinces.

kesiapan_strategis.title: Strategic Preparedness
kesiapan_strategis.description: Complete advanced military construction or strategic defense programs.

tanggap_bencana.title: Disaster Response
tanggap_bencana.description: Deploy aid and restore normal conditions following natural disasters.

krisis_teratasi.title: Crisis Resolved
krisis_teratasi.description: Contain epidemic outbreaks until disease spread is fully halted.

negara_tangguh.title: Resilient State
negara_tangguh.description: Restore vital services post-crisis without prolonged civilian deprivations.
